title: Devin AI: is the first AI software engineer worth the hype?

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Is Devin AI the real deal—or just another overhyped tool in the AI arms race?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Devin can write code, debug, and deploy apps, but it still lacks deep domain-specific knowledge and contextual judgment.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If Devin replaces human engineers, we risk devaluing expertise and widening the gap between tech and non-tech workers.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating human-in-the-loop systems to ensure oversight and maintain ethical and practical boundaries.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In five years, Devin could enable faster innovation, democratizing software development for small teams and startups.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future hinges on balancing AI’s potential with human values, ensuring progress doesn’t come at the cost of equity.

video_cue: A split-screen showing a developer working with Devin AI on one side and a diverse team of engineers collaborating on the other.
